name: Worklog: Timesheets
description: Timesheet and work log written by your coding agents: what was done each day, per project and area, collected automatically from agent notes and Git commits. Monthly report export as Markdown or CSV for clients or your manager.

cover.alt: Worklog panel in Orca's sidebar: today's work grouped by client project and area, with hours, agent notes and a commit, plus the status bar item.

screenshots.alt: Worklog panel in Orca's sidebar: today's work grouped by client project and area, with hours, agent notes and a commit, plus the status bar item.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Language of the panel, the reports and the notes agents are asked to write.

settings.title: Include my Git commits
settings.description: Adds your own commits (matched by git config user.email) from local repositories, so work is logged even when an agent left no note.

settings.title: Keep .worklog out of Git
settings.description: Adds .worklog/ to each local repository's .git/info/exclude, which only applies on this computer and is never committed.

commands.title: Worklog: Show what I did today
